title: geum aleppicum subsp. strictum
intro: Geum aleppicum subsp. strictum, commonly known as the strict purple avens, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a perennial herb that grows in wetlands, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geum aleppicum subsp. strictum are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antioxidant activities, suggesting its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
